edits.original: Those upgrades are planned on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.replacement: Those upgrades are planned on purpose.
edits.reason: “By accident” is the ordinary general-knowledge antonym of “on purpose,” so the trailing “rather than by accident” clause adds nothing and is cut.

edits.original: Operators procured spinning reserve, rather than non-spinning reserve.
edits.replacement: Operators procured spinning reserve: capacity that is online and synchronized, ready to raise output immediately. Non-spinning reserve is capacity that is available but not yet synchronized; it must be started before it can deliver power.
edits.reason: “Non-spinning reserve” is a technical rather than ordinary-knowledge contrast to “spinning reserve,” so the genuine distinction is given its own sentence stated as what each reserve is.
